human_summary: A bus crash near Erulia Bazar in Bogura Sadar upazila killed seven people and injured others [ev_3d9b6f7ef1b8f36b, ev_b02f78dc220fb6ca, ev_be00c7adf6f585e6]. The incident occurred on the Bogura-Naogaon regional highway around 5:30am local time [ev_3d9b6f7ef1b8f36b]. A senior fire service officer reported that the bus, operated by Shah Fateh Ali Paribahan and heading to Naogaon from Dhaka, suffered brake failure when yielding to a motorcycle, struck an electricity pole, and then hit labourers and bystanders [ev_7d10439deaca950c]. The bus lacked a route permit for the past 1.5 years, according to BRTA [ev_c8197f78704ba550]. All sources agree on seven fatalities; the injury count is not specified. The location is cited as Sherpur, Bogura with city-level granularity, a representative centroid [ev_b02f78dc220fb6ca]. After the crash, locals blocked the road demanding speed breakers; an official promised installation soon [ev_3c2f6e349cdbbcef]. A committee was formed to investigate and report within three days [ev_35ec9cf7714b6c1c], and the government offered compensation to victims [ev_5a31009168ec3910]. The incident is covered by two independent sources: The Daily Star and Ekattor TV [src_dfdb7ca9eb9e785d, src_fdc9d6452f3a9057]. Key unresolved uncertainty includes the exact cause (brake failure is attributed, not confirmed) and the precise number of injured.
